uncited: **Bounding Box (BBox):** Axis-aligned box tightly enclosing training camera frustums.
*   For each grid point $j$, count the number of training views $n_j$ to which it is visible.
*   Determine $n_{\max}$, the maximum view count across all grid points.
*   **Query:** Interpolate density $\dot{\sigma}^{(c)}$ and color $\mathbf{c}^{(c)}$ from $V^{(\text{density})(c)}$ and $V^{(\text{rgb})(c)}$ at query points $x_i$.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing two dense grids ($V^{(\text{density})(c)}$ and $V^{(\text{rgb})(c)}$) at coarse resolution.

*   **Limitations:** The coarse grid is dense, which may be inefficient for very large scenes compared to sparse methods like [Bonxai](16862-bonxai.md) or [Sparse Voxel Storage](15595-sparse-voxel-storage-and-chunking.md).
*   **When to use:** When rapid convergence is needed and the scene fits within a manageable bounding box.
